content.bridge_context: Transitioning from personal bravery to national service, this chapter honours the sacrifices of soldiers.

units.title: The Meaning of Valor
units.explanation: Valor is great courage in the face of danger, especially in battle.
units.dual_language_instruction: Think of a synonym for valor. / वीरता का पर्यायवाची सोचें।

units.title: Service and Sacrifice
units.explanation: Soldiers serve the country by protecting its borders and citizens, often at great personal cost.
units.dual_language_instruction: List ways soldiers help during peace and war. / शांति और युद्ध के दौरान सैनिक मदद करने के तरीकों की सूची बनाएं।
